mapper.select: SELECT s.*, c.course_name, c.course_code, c.classification, c.credit FROM score s LEFT JOIN course c ON s.course_id = c.course_id WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY s.semester DESC, c.course_code

SELECT s.*, st.student_name, st.student_no, u.username FROM score s LEFT JOIN student st ON s.student_id = st.student_id LEFT JOIN user u ON s.student_id = u.user_id WHERE s.course_id = #{courseId} AND s.semester = #{semester} ORDER BY s.score_score DESC

SELECT sch.schedule_id, sch.course_id, sch.semester, sch.week_day, sch.start_period, sch.end_period, c.course_name, c.course_code, c.classification, c.credit, cr.classroom_name, cap.current_count AS enrolled_count, cap.max_capacity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM score sc WHERE sc.course_id = sch.course_id) AS graded_count FROM schedule sch LEFT JOIN course c ON sch.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN classroom cr ON sch.classroom_id = cr.classroom_id LEFT JOIN course_capacity cap ON sch.schedule_id = cap.schedule_id AND sch.semester = cap.semester WHERE sch.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND sch.semester = #{semester} ORDER BY sch.week_day, sch.start_period

SELECT s.student_id, st.student_name, st.student_no, COUNT(CASE WHEN sc.status = 0 THEN 1 END) AS fail_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.status = 0 THEN COALESCE(c.credit, 2) ELSE 0 END) AS fail_credits, SUM(CASE WHEN sc.semester = #{semester} AND sc.status = 0 THEN COALESCE(c.credit, 2) ELSE 0 END) AS current_fail_credits FROM student st JOIN score sc ON st.student_id = sc.student_id LEFT JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.course_id JOIN ( -- 辅导员所辖班级学生：通过 grade 关联 SELECT DISTINCT s2.student_id FROM student s2 WHERE s2.grade_id IN ( SELECT g.grade_id FROM grade g -- 实际业务中 counselor_id 关联逻辑由应用层处理 ) ) s ON st.student_id = s.student_id WHERE sc.status = 0 GROUP BY s.student_id, st.student_name, st.student_no HAVING fail_credits >= 10 ORDER BY fail_credits DESC
